learnings.pattern: Missing CORS middleware causes browser API blocking on review apps
learnings.diagnosis: server.js middleware chain had NO CORS middleware at all. Only a single Access-Control-Allow-Origin:'*' header on one endpoint. Browser preflight OPTIONS requests received no CORS headers, blocking all API calls.
learnings.fix: Add global CORS handler as FIRST middleware (before express.json): set Access-Control-Allow-Origin from CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS env or '*', set Allow-Methods/Allow-Headers, handle OPTIONS preflight with 204 response.

learnings.pattern: Review app configuration pipeline — env vars not inherited from parent pipeline
learnings.diagnosis: Heroku review apps auto-created from PRs do NOT inherit config vars from staging/production pipeline environments. Only HEROKU_APP_NAME, HEROKU_BRANCH, HEROKU_PR_NUMBER, and NODE_ENV are auto-set.
learnings.fix: Must manually copy critical env vars (DATABASE_URL, REDIS_URL, STREAM_SECRET, GROQ_API_KEY) from staging via Heroku API PATCH /apps/:app/config-vars. Then DELETE /apps/:app/dynos to restart.

learnings.pattern: Heroku eco tier dyno limit is per-account, not per-app
learnings.diagnosis: The 2-dyno eco limit applies ACROSS ALL APPS in the account. If production has 4 eco dynos, even a review app with 1 web dyno will fail because total account exceeds limit.
learnings.fix: Set review app worker dynos to quantity:0. Reduce top-level formation from 4 to 1 dyno if total account usage exceeds 2 eco dynos.
